name: Nocturne
about: A gothic castle stormed by night, for a metroidvania: aged gold on black, a serif, health in crimson and magic in a deep blue, a Victorian cresting over every window and a vignette over the castle. What is found is said in gold across the top, a power with a bell; a save is a quiet chime. Nothing leans and nothing slams: the castle is the show.
author: mojulo
title: wipe
